items.title: Intuitive wins CE mark for transvaginal gynaecological procedures on da Vinci SP
items.summary: Intuitive announced on 14 September 2026 that the da Vinci SP single-port system has received CE mark approval for transvaginal gynaecological procedures, which the company describes as a world-first indication for the SP platform.

items.title: Hologic wins £120k Sonata Fibroid Ablation device order for Glan Clwyd Hospital
items.summary: Betsi Cadwaladr University Health Board has purchased a Sonata Fibroid Ablation Device from Hologic Ltd for Glan Clwyd Hospital, awarded via the NHS Supply Chain Dynamic Purchasing System for Medical Technology Innovation.
